vars.prTitle: feat(stripe): show formatted price preview in event type payment settings
vars.prBody: The price field in the Stripe event type settings is a bare number input, so it is not obvious how the amount will be shown to bookers (currency symbol, separators, locale). This adds a small preview under the input using the shared `formatPrice` helper, the same one used on the booking page. The presentable amount is computed once and reused for the input value and the preview.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "The preview passes `displayPrice`, which is already converted to the presentable unit by convertFromSmallestToPresentableCurrencyUnit, into formatPrice. But formatPrice in packages/lib/price.ts (line 12) expects the amount in the smallest currency unit and itself calls convertFromSmallestToPresentableCurrencyUnit, which divides by 100 for every non-zero-decimal currency (packages/app-store/stripepayment/lib/currencyConversions.ts:36). The amount is therefore divided twice: a $50.00 event shows a preview of \"$0.50\", misleading organizers about what bookers will be charged. formatPrice should receive the raw `price` (smallest unit), not `displayPrice`.", "severity": "High"}]
